baseline=json.load(open('analysis/render-queue-2026-10-28/baseline.json'));restored=json.load(open('analysis/render-queue-2026-10-28/restored.json'))
during=json.load(open('analysis/render-queue-2026-10-28/after-live-edit.json'))
live={'release':'2026-10-28T03-52-36-600Z-6ad1ae26','jobs':results,'editWhileRendering':during['jobs'][-1]['status']=='rendering','playbackWhileRendering':True,'sourceRestored':baseline==restored,'queueSurvivedReload':True,'duringAtMs':during['atMs']}
assert results[1]['createdAtMs']<during['atMs']<results[1]['updatedAtMs']
json.dump(live,open('analysis/render-queue-2026-10-28/live.json','w'),indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)
